sections.heading: Certifications
Covers
sections.wikitext:
The song was covered by [[Donny Osmond]] on his 2009 album ''Love Songs Of The '70s''. [[Phish]] did two renditions in 1999, including on 10 September at [[The Gorge Amphitheatre]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://relisten.net/phish/1999/9/21 |title=Phish Relisten |website=relisten.net |access-date=2016-12-22}}</ref> [[Orlando Brown (actor)|Orlando Brown]] recorded it for the 2006 soundtrack album ''[[That's So Raven Too!]]'', for his [[Disney Channel]] series ''[[That's So Raven]]''; his version was also featured in the Disney Channel original film ''[[Wendy Wu: Homecoming Warrior]]''.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://uk.imdb.com/title/tt0790781/soundtrack |website=IMDb.com|title=Wendy Wu: Homecoming Warrior Entry|access-date=2016-10-08}}</ref> The song was performed in [[Hebrew]] by [[Yehonatan Geffen]] and [[Dani Litani]] in their 1974 live show ''That's All for Now - For Now That's All''.<ref>{{Discogs release|id=6078916|name=בינתיים זה הכל|type=album}}</ref> 

In 2024 the [[Dave Matthews Band]] covered the song during their summer tour with [[Dave Matthews]] singing the first verse and keyboardist [[Buddy Strong]] taking over the chorus and closing.{{cn|date=May 2026}}
sections.text:
The song was covered by Donny Osmond on his 2009 album Love Songs Of The '70s. Phish did two renditions in 1999, including on 10 September at The Gorge Amphitheatre. Orlando Brown recorded it for the 2006 soundtrack album That's So Raven Too!, for his Disney Channel series That's So Raven; his version was also featured in the Disney Channel original film Wendy Wu: Homecoming Warrior. The song was performed in Hebrew by Yehonatan Geffen and Dani Litani in their 1974 live show That's All for Now - For Now That's All. 

In 2024 the Dave Matthews Band covered the song during their summer tour with Dave Matthews singing the first verse and keyboardist Buddy Strong taking over the chorus and closing.{{cn|date=May 2026}}
